summary: The ES lead covers only the late-19th-century reformulation of Jewish identity via race science by early Zionists such as Nordau. The EN lead includes this opening but adds substantial later sections on assimilationist alternatives, institutional rejections, 1930s defensive racial redefinitions, the Holocaust's impact, Israel's founding and Law of Return, and criticisms of modern genetic research as shaped by Zionist narratives—all absent from the provided ES text.
